title: American Battleship New Jersey USS IOWA Class Battle ship 16inch guns firing
method: Frame grabs from the supplied YouTube video in Orca, decoded at the listed video timestamps.
observations: The clip cuts between two firing views; the frames are not one continuous eight-second plume.
At 0.5 s the first view has broad fire envelopes. At 1.5 and 2.5 s the smoke remains a connected mass with large rounded folds.
The second view shows firing at 4 s and a cohesive plume at 6 and 8 s, with gentle spreading and softening.
Use the apparent motion as a visual reference. Upload playback speed, color grading, gun conditions and exact physical timing are not independently verified.
usage: Visual comparison only. Reference frames are not game textures and are not embedded in the review artifact.
